parameters.query: ={{ 'UPDATE context_blocks SET embedding = \'' + JSON.stringify($json.embeddings[0]) + '\' WHERE id = \'' + $('Execute Query').item.json.id + '\'' }}

WITH auth_update AS (
  UPDATE context_api_keys SET last_used_at = now()
  WHERE key_hash = encode(digest('{{ $json.apiKey }}', 'sha256'), 'hex') AND active = true
  RETURNING home_scope, allowed_scopes
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT home_scope FROM auth_update LIMIT 1),
  '__UNAUTHORIZED__'
) AS home_scope,
COALESCE(
  (SELECT allowed_scopes FROM auth_update LIMIT 1),
  '{}'::text[]
) AS allowed_scopes
